title: You and Your Sibling on a Thali
prompt: Turn the two people in the attached photos into tiny miniature figures, each about two centimetres tall, celebrating Bhai Dooj in the centre of a giant polished brass puja thali. Keep both faces, skin tones and hairstyles exactly the same as in the photos; do not beautify or change identity. The sister (photo 1) gently presses a red roli tilak onto her brother's forehead (photo 2), and both smile softly, sitting cross-legged facing each other. She wears a magenta silk saree with a gold border; he wears a cream kurta with a saffron dupatta. Around them lie rice grains as big as pillows, a small hill of red kumkum, and one lit clay diya whose single flame towers behind them like a bonfire. Marigold petals are scattered on a dark wooden floor at night. Warm diya glow is the key light, with deep shadows at the edges. Macro tilt-shift photograph, 100mm macro lens, f/2.8, high-angle three-quarter view, both faces clearly visible. Photorealistic, rich amber and crimson colour grade, hammered brass reflections, silk sheen, tiny embroidery stitches. No text. Aspect ratio 4:5.
tip: Attach your sister's photo first, then your brother's.
